notes.title: August 20th Update
notes.notes:
Fixed various typos.
 Streamlined flowchart 4 to make it more intuitive to complete.
 Fixed a bug where flowchart 4 would fail to load under certain circumstances.
 Fixed a bug where going from the flowchart to the endings screen would cause the flowchart to still be clickable.
 Fixed a bug where resetting the second puzzle in Room 3 would leave some names in red.
 Fixed issues where, in the path following door 4, some characters referred to it as door 3.
 Fixed an issue with Brendan knowing Spanish before he was supposed to.
 Fixed an issue where jumping to a certain node in flowchart 4 would not display any images.
 Fixed alignment issues in the puzzles of door 4.
 Added OpenSans as optional font in the Accessibility menu.
